Body.Content:
We are announcing the task completion grader in Copilot Studio. This feature reached general availability on October 15, 2026.

How does this affect me?
This feature enables you to evaluate whether your agents successfully accomplish their intended tasks, beyond simply generating a relevant or high-quality response. This helps you to identify functional failures, improve agent reliability, and gain greater confidence that agents are delivering the expected business outcomes.

What action do I need to take?
This message is for awareness, and no action is required.
